name: Niagara Bottling - North Las Vegas NV

fieldNotes.facility: Niagara Bottling North Las Vegas, 6445 E El Campo Grande Ave. Confirmed by red 'niagara' logo on the building front and a blue 'niagara EXIT GATE' sign in Street View (2026-02). Modern build-to-suit in a dense industrial park.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Z20 satellite shows a controlled truck gate at the NE corner where the truck drive meets the road - barrier-arm elements across the drive, chain-link perimeter fence, and a tractor staged at the gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly staffed multi-window guard booth at the lane; the gate uses barrier arms. Treated as automated / remote check-in.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Controlled gate (barrier arms, signed EXIT GATE) with no manned booth implies kiosk / app / remote check-in.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Z21 satellite shows three lanes painted 'EXIT' with out-pointing arrows near the NE corner, separate from the inbound truck lane - distinct in/out gates.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Three painted EXIT lanes visible. entryLanes estimated at 1 (inbound), low-confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long row of dock doors along the full east face with multiple trailers backed in; estimated ~40 doors. Counted from z19 imagery, flagged approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large dock apron / trailer yard along the east face shared with the neighboring building, full of parked trailers.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Open desert and unused paved width on the west side and at the gate apron; room to add an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense North Las Vegas industrial/warehouse park - Urban.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single large Niagara building; the building immediately east is a separate tenant sharing the dock-yard drive aisle.
